description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the LDAPConfigAPI class within the OrangeHRM LDAP plugin. It tests fetching, updating, and validation behavior of LDAP configuration via API endpoints, including setting up LDAP settings in fixtures and mocking services.

classes.name: LDAPConfigAPITest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing LDAP configuration API endpoints in OrangeHRM, including get, update, and delete operations.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests fetching a single LDAP configuration based on provided test case parameters.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for testing getOne API method from a YAML data file.

methods.name: saveLDAPConfigPreHook
methods.description: Static method that sets up LDAP configuration settings in the database before tests.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating the LDAP configuration with given test case parameters.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for testing update API method from a YAML data file.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests that the delete operation throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests that getValidationRuleForDelete method throws a 'not implemented' exception.
